question: Sitara Devi, a doyen of _________ Dance, was hailed as the Queen of Kathak by Rabindranath Tagore.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sitara Devi** was a renowned Indian classical dancer of the **Kathak** genre.
 
• She was hailed as the **Queen of Kathak** by the Nobel laureate **Rabindranath Tagore**.
 
• Sitara Devi's contribution to Kathak has been immense, and she is celebrated for her vibrant and dynamic performances.
 
• She has been a recipient of several prestigious awards, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and the **Padma Shree**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• The word **Kathak** is derived from the Vedic Sanskrit word **Katha** which means "story", and **Kathakar** which means "the one who tells a story".
 
• Kathak dancers tell various stories through their hand movements and extensive footwork, but most importantly through their facial expressions.
 
• The dance form traces its origins to the nomadic bards of ancient northern India, known as **Kathakars** or storytellers.
